value.name: Lucia reports placement options
value.description: Lucia explains that Wynnewood has a respite bed open through Sunday and that the other facilities are waitlisted or require a fresh assessment.
evidence: the Wynnewood place had a respite bed open through Sunday and the woman on the phone had actually called her back twice
The other three, Lucia said, were either waitlisted or wouldn't take someone at their mother's level without a fresh assessment

value.name: Asha realizes Wynnewood is the plan
value.description: Asha understands that Wynnewood is the facility they will start with and that the calling effort will no longer be Lucia's alone.
evidence: Asha understood that Wynnewood was the one they were going to start with at six, and that the calling, when it resumed, was not going to be Lucia's alone

value.name: Asha guides Lucia to sit
value.description: Asha enters the room, steadies Lucia by the back, and steers her into the chair by the window.
evidence: Asha stepped past the doorframe into the room and put her hand at the small of Lucia's back, steering her to the upholstered chair near the window where the night aide usually charted

value.name: Lucia keeps the page and smooths it
value.description: Lucia sits with the half-page on her knee and absentmindedly smooths its crease, showing continued focus on the placement notes.
evidence: kept the half-page on her knee, smoothing the crease with her thumb

value.name: Asha asks about morning intake calls
value.description: Asha asks who will handle the morning intake calls, noting that Wynnewood needs a callback by nine and other waitlists still need follow-up.
evidence: Asha crouched so their faces were level and asked who was going to handle the intake calls in the morning
because Wynnewood would want a callback by nine and there were two waitlists to push on while that bed was still open

value.name: Lucia asks Asha to make the calls
value.description: Lucia admits she cannot handle the talking today and asks Asha to call the facilities instead.
evidence: she touched Asha's forearm, barely, and said, can you call them, I can't do the talking today

value.name: Asha accepts the responsibility
value.description: Asha pauses to acknowledge the request as a real request, then agrees to take over the calls.
evidence: Asha did not answer right away; she let the request sit between them long enough for Lucia to know she had heard it as a request and not as the old default, and then she said she would take the calls

value.name: Asha assigns Lucia the site visit
value.description: Asha tells Lucia that she will be the one to drive out and inspect the room before they proceed.
evidence: Lucia would be the one to drive out and see the room before they
